title: Protocol Wizard product library — schema version 1
description: One product and its protocols. The app validates the selection, installed component dependencies, and the merged library before installation.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint for JSON validation and completion. The app uses its bundled schema and does not download this URL.
$schema.title: Editor schema URL

schemaVersion.title: File format version
schemaVersion.description: Library file format version. Use the integer 1 during development.

catalogVersion.title: Catalog version
catalogVersion.description: Content version marker. Use the integer 1 during development; the app detects content updates by SHA-256 digest.

items.title: Product
items.description: Exactly one product identity. Include its reusable protocols in the protocols array; importing does not create a personal product or start a schedule.

protocols.title: Protocols
protocols.description: One or more reusable protocols for the included product. Each productID must equal items[0].id. Users choose which protocols to import.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Source records referenced by citations. Use an empty array when there are none; citation sourceIDs must resolve within this file.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Links from a product or protocol to a source, with optional location and evidence context. Use an empty array when there are none.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Grouping labels referenced by the product's categoryID. Use an empty array when the product has no category.

methods.title: Delivery methods
methods.description: Labels for supported delivery IDs used by the protocols. Each protocol's methodID must resolve within this file.

nonblank.title: Nonblank text
nonblank.description: A string containing at least one non-whitespace character. Use stable IDs and meaningful names where a field refers to this definition.

methodID.title: Delivery method ID
methodID.description: An exact, lowercase delivery choice supported by the app. Use unspecified when the user should choose the method; a custom display label does not allow a new ID.

id.title: Product ID
id.description: Stable product identifier. Matching IDs update the same installed reference product; use a namespace to avoid collisions with other authors.

name.title: Product name
name.description: Display name for the product. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

aliases.title: Alternative names
aliases.description: Other names readers may use for this product. Use an empty array when there are none.

kind.title: Product kind
kind.description: Classifies the identity as a product, blend, other item, or unresolved item. Use one of the exact listed values.

identityStatus.title: Identity status
identityStatus.description: Use resolved for a confirmed identity or needs_confirmation when the identity still needs clarification.

categoryID.title: Category ID
categoryID.description: Integer ID of a category in this file. Omit or set to null when the product has no category.

benefits.title: Benefits and context
benefits.description: Optional text describing intended benefits and their supporting context or limitations. Omit or set to null when unavailable.

timing.title: Timing guidance
timing.description: Optional dose-timing guidance for this product. The app shows it as a recommendation on the Schedule step and never applies it automatically.

tags.title: Timing tags
tags.description: Any of: morning, midday, evening, bedtime, empty_stomach, with_food, before_exercise, after_exercise. Unknown tags are ignored.

window.title: Suggested window
window.description: 24-hour HH:mm start and end. The end may be earlier than the start, meaning the window crosses midnight.

note.title: Timing note
note.description: Shown under the recommendation. Up to 500 characters.

item.title: Product
item.description: The single product described by this library file. Keep its ID stable so future imports can update the same reference entry.

id.title: Protocol ID
id.description: Stable identifier for this reusable protocol. A matching installed ID can update the same protocol but cannot move it to a different product.

productID.title: Product ID
productID.description: ID of the one product included in items. All protocols in this file must belong to that product.

title.title: Protocol title
title.description: Display name that distinguishes this routine from other protocols for the product. Must be nonblank.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Optional explanation of the routine's intended goal. Omit or set to null when unavailable.

methodID.title: Delivery method ID
methodID.description: Supported delivery ID for this routine. Include a matching entry in the file's methods array.

population.title: Intended audience
population.description: Text describing who the source routine applies to. Use an empty string when no audience is specified.

evidenceNotes.title: Evidence notes
evidenceNotes.description: Optional qualifications, uncertainties, or source context for this routine. Omit or set to null when unavailable.

regimen.title: Regimen
regimen.description: Required version 1 regimen with at least one phase. It supplies reusable reference settings, not an active personal schedule.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: A reusable routine for the included product. Importing adds reference content; the user creates and confirms a personal schedule separately.

id.title: Source ID
id.description: Stable identifier used by citation sourceIDs in this file. Namespace it to avoid collisions with other authors.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS source URL without embedded credentials. The app also checks the parsed URL; it does not fetch the source during import.
url.title: Source URL

title.title: Source title
title.description: Display title of the source material.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Optional authoring organization or publisher name. Omit or set to null when unavailable.

type.description: Free-form source category. The listed examples are suggestions, not a fixed set of choices.
type.title: Source type

publishedAt.title: Publication date
publishedAt.description: Optional publication date retained as text, without date parsing or a required date format. Omit or set to null when unavailable.

source.title: Source
source.description: A bibliographic record with a stable ID and an HTTP or HTTPS URL. Citations use this ID to link supporting material to a product or protocol.

protocolID.title: Protocol target ID
protocolID.description: ID of a protocol in this file. Provide a nonblank value when citing a protocol; otherwise omit this field or set it to null.

productID.title: Product target ID
productID.description: ID of the product in this file. Provide a nonblank value when citing the product; otherwise omit this field or set it to null.

sourceID.title: Source ID
sourceID.description: ID of the supporting source record in this file.

locator.title: Source location
locator.description: Optional page, section, table, or other locator within the source. Omit or set to null when unavailable.

evidenceNote.title: Evidence note
evidenceNote.description: Optional explanation of what the source supports and any relevant limits. Omit or set to null when unavailable.

supports.title: Supported fields
supports.description: Field names or reference paths supported by this citation, such as /phases or /benefits. The app retains these strings as descriptions and does not resolve them as JSON Pointers.

protocolID.title: Protocol target ID
protocolID.description: Nonblank ID of the protocol this citation supports.

productID.title: Unused product target
productID.description: For a protocol citation, omit productID or set it to null. A citation cannot target both a product and a protocol.

oneOf.title: Protocol citation
oneOf.description: Requires a nonblank protocolID. Omit productID or set it to null so the citation has only one target.

productID.title: Product target ID
productID.description: Nonblank ID of the product this citation supports.

protocolID.title: Unused protocol target
protocolID.description: For a product citation, omit protocolID or set it to null. A citation cannot target both a product and a protocol.

oneOf.title: Product citation
oneOf.description: Requires a nonblank productID. Omit protocolID or set it to null so the citation has only one target.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: Connects one source to exactly one target: provide a nonblank protocolID or productID, never both. The unused target may be omitted or null. The source and target must exist in this file; the app checks these relationships.

id.title: Category ID
id.description: Integer identifier unique within the categories array. Reuse an installed ID only for the same category.

name.title: Category name
name.description: Nonblank display label for the grouping.

category.title: Category
category.description: A product grouping label with an integer ID. Reuse an installed ID only for the same category; changes to shared labels require replacement confirmation.

id.title: Delivery method ID
id.description: Supported delivery choice unique within the methods array. Protocol methodIDs refer to this value.

name.title: Delivery method label
name.description: Nonblank display label for the delivery method. Changing the label does not expand the supported ID choices.

method.title: Delivery method
method.description: A display label for a supported delivery method ID. The ID must use an app choice even when the label is customized.

cautions.title: Cautions
cautions.description: Optional source context for exclusions, interactions, monitoring, and reported effects. This reference metadata does not create alerts or monitoring tasks.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

spacing_between_components.title: Spacing between components
spacing_between_components.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

repeat_rule.title: Repeat rule
repeat_rule.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

exact_sequence.title: Exact sequence
exact_sequence.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

doses_per_day.title: Doses per day
doses_per_day.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

approximate.title: Approximate dose
approximate.description: Whether the source describes the amount as approximate.

basis.title: Dose basis
basis.description: How to interpret the quantity, such as per administration, a daily total, a component amount, or a body-weight amount. This label does not convert quantities or choose a personal dose.

maximum.title: Maximum dose
maximum.description: Upper end of a source-reported dose range as a plain decimal string. The user chooses a concrete personal dose.

minimum.title: Minimum dose
minimum.description: Lower end of a source-reported dose range as a plain decimal string, or null when unknown. The user chooses a concrete personal dose.

options.title: Dose choices
options.description: Alternative source-reported quantities as plain decimal strings in the stated unit. Listing choices does not select a personal dose.

unit.title: Dose unit
unit.description: Exact app-supported unit for all quantities in this dose object. IU represents biological activity and does not imply a mass conversion.

value.title: Dose amount
value.description: Single dose quantity as a plain decimal string, such as 0.25 or 500, or null when unknown. Use a dot for the decimal separator and no grouping commas or unit suffix.

dose.description: Required dose content: a decimal string value, a minimum/maximum range, options, or null when unknown. Dose objects need a supported unit. The app checks plain decimal strings; ranges and component or body-weight amounts are not automatically chosen.
dose.title: Phase dose

kind.title: Duration kind
kind.description: Describes a fixed length, a range, a minimum or maximum, an ongoing or unreported duration, or a source-defined target. Only fixed day or week lengths can seed a concrete editor duration.

maximum.title: Maximum duration
maximum.description: Upper duration bound in the stated unit, or null when unreported. A source range does not choose a personal duration.

minimum.title: Minimum duration
minimum.description: Lower duration bound in the stated unit, or null when unreported. A source range does not choose a personal duration.

unit.title: Duration unit
unit.description: Unit for the duration amount and bounds: day, week, or calendar_month. Calendar months are retained as reference context.

value.title: Duration amount
value.description: Single duration amount in the stated unit. Use an integer from 1 through 365000, or null when unreported.

duration.title: Phase duration
duration.description: Required description of how long this stage lasts. Choose kind and include the applicable value or bounds with their unit. Ongoing or unreported durations can omit a numeric amount.

name.title: Phase name
name.description: Nonblank display label for this stage, such as Initial phase or Maintenance.

description.title: Schedule description
description.description: Optional source wording or explanation that a structured pattern alone cannot express.

doses_per_day.title: Doses per day
doses_per_day.description: Number of administrations on each dosing day, from 1 through 1440, or null when unreported.

interval_days.title: Days between doses
interval_days.description: Interval in days for every_n_days, from 1 through 365000, or null when unreported.

pattern.title: Schedule pattern
pattern.description: Describes daily, interval, selected weekdays, weekly frequency, as-needed, or source-described use. Users must choose a valid personal schedule before saving.

items.title: Local dose time
items.description: One local time in 24-hour HH:mm format, such as 09:00.

suggested_times.description: Local 24-hour times in HH:mm format. An empty array leaves times for the user to choose; importing does not schedule reminders.
suggested_times.title: Suggested dose times

times_per_week.title: Doses per week
times_per_week.description: Source-reported weekly frequency from 1 through 7, or null when unreported. A weekly count alone does not select dosing weekdays.

items.title: ISO weekday
items.description: One integer from 1 for Monday through 7 for Sunday.

weekdays.description: ISO weekday numbers for the routine: Monday is 1 and Sunday is 7.
weekdays.title: Dosing weekdays

schedule.title: Phase schedule
schedule.description: Required description of when doses occur. Choose a pattern and the relevant count, interval, weekdays, or suggested times. Reference alternatives do not become an active schedule on import.

items.title: Phase
items.description: One stage of the reusable routine. Reference ranges, alternatives, and source descriptions still require the user to choose valid personal settings.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: Required, nonempty list of routine stages in source order. Each stage needs a name, duration, dose, and schedule.

component_id.title: Component ID
component_id.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

diluent.title: Diluent
diluent.description: Source-reported diluent name for this preparation option.

diluent_volume.title: Diluent volume
diluent_volume.description: Source-reported diluent quantity with its unit, or null when unknown. Do not infer a final solution volume from this field.

dry_amount.title: Dry product amount
dry_amount.description: Source-reported dry quantity with its unit, or null when unknown.

final_solution_volume.title: Final solution volume
final_solution_volume.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

form.title: Product form
form.description: Source description of the product's physical form for this option.

reconstitution_required.title: Reconstitution required
reconstitution_required.description: Whether the source preparation requires mixing before use.

source_reported_concentration.title: Source concentration
source_reported_concentration.description: Source-reported concentration with its unit, or null when unknown. Retain the source quantity rather than inferring a personal calculation.

items.title: Preparation option
items.description: One source-reported preparation alternative. Amounts, volumes, and concentrations describe reference content; users enter their own personal product details.

preparation_options.title: Preparation options
preparation_options.description: Optional alternatives for product form, amounts, diluent, and concentration. Keep quantities and units explicit; the app retains this reference metadata without preparing a personal product.

regimen_type.description: Use single_compound for one product, premixed_blend for a prepared blend, or stack for separate components. Stacks are viewable reference content and cannot be activated as a single personal protocol.
regimen_type.title: Regimen type

minimum.title: Minimum
minimum.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

minimum.title: Minimum
minimum.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

expiry.title: Expiry
expiry.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Optional source-reported storage, handling, and discard guidance. This reference metadata does not set personal expiry dates or reminders.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Reserved in the version 1 format; if provided, this field must be null.

version.title: Regimen version
version.description: Regimen format version. Use the integer 1 during development, including for content updates.

regimen.description: The reusable dose, duration, and schedule content of a protocol. Version and phases are required. Optional source metadata supplies context; the editor only copies settings it understands.
regimen.title: Regimen

decimal_amount.title: Decimal amount
decimal_amount.description: A plain period-separated decimal string, such as 0.25 or 500. Signs, exponents, grouping separators, and whitespace are invalid.
